sentences.text: On 1.31, you can create a service account token bound to a specific Node by using the `kubectl create token` command with the `--bound-object-kind Node --bound-object-name <node-name> --bound-object-uid` flags when the `ServiceAccountTokenNodeBinding` feature gate is enabled.

citations.quote: kubectl create token build-robot --bound-object-kind Node --bound-object-name node-001 --bound-object-uid
